changes.comment: Release fully retired Team stores and read historical records from disk while preserving live owners, queued writes and cleanup. Keep an admitted leader dissolve on that captured owner through its asynchronous precheck and detached cleanup, even when initial construction fails. Restore non-blocking Codex inbound and final-parent behavioral coverage with explicit native-model opt-in and separate auth-free protocol checks. Retain revocable event sources and skip display DTO production without an audience while preserving durable observations. Restore actual ESLint code-line limits and public package boundary assertions. Ignore non-Team inventory names without reading or altering their contents, and keep one construction record acquisition through workspace preparation and publication. Pure retained-record reads return the committed snapshot without waiting for unrelated queued writes; writer releases still drain their captured queues.
